title: Arvel Skeen
description: When Cassian Andor joined the Aldhani mission, one of his crewmates was Arvel Skeen. Skeen resisted adding someone to the squad just before the mission. Afte the heist, the group laid low while Karis Nemik received medical treatment. Skeen told Andor that they should take off with the credits. Realizing that Skeen was a threat, Andor gunned him down.
